supersedes.reason: Retain model-visible history in observational conditioning; separate observed feedback-selected action sequences from do(A); distinguish task Goal from query Goal and scope randomized-query information claims.

core_specification: For fixed augmented physical state s, low-level executed actions a covering the entire forecast horizon, and paired exogenous noise u, changing preference-only query Goal does not change Y_physical(s, do(A=a), do(G=g), u). This is not an assertion that P_train(Y | O,A,G) is independent of G.

causal_estimand.structural_equation: S_next = F(S, A, U); Y_physical = H(S_future). G is excluded only when it is preference-only metadata, not a dynamics/reset/control input.
causal_estimand.paired_counterfactual: Y_physical(s, do(A=a), do(G=g1), u) = Y_physical(s, do(A=a), do(G=g2), u)
causal_estimand.distributional_version: If exogenous noise is not paired, require equal physical outcome distributions under the two interventions, not equal samples.
fixed_state_includes: sensor/rendering parameters relevant to the target
causal_estimand.fixed_action_requirement: Freeze and execute the complete low-level open-loop control sequence and duration covering every evaluated future step. Observing the same action sequence in feedback-policy data does not implement do(A=a); do not hold only the first action or high-level command fixed.
falsifiers: Goal changes uncommitted actions, another agent, controller semantics or horizon
The scored output contains goal-relative reward/semantics instead of a physical consequence

observational_prediction_boundary.identity: P_train(Y | H,A,G_query) = integral P_train(Y | S,H,A,G_query) P_train(S | H,A,G_query) dS. This is an observational identity, not a Goal-free interventional transition kernel.
observational_prediction_boundary.counterexample: An instruction can reveal a hidden object location or be correlated with unobserved object properties. Two identical visible observations need not justify equal conditional forecasts across goals.
observational_prediction_boundary.needed_for_distributional_invariance: Establish Y independent of G_query given model-visible H and the committed action intervention in the target distribution, or identify an explicit instruction-isolated/interventional forecast contract. This is separate from observational training-distribution conditioning.
not_established: All crossed observation/action/Goal triples are within training support
A pretrained observational conditional predictor must be invariant under a new randomized-query distribution
observational_prediction_boundary.single_seed_warning: Common-random-number sample differences demonstrate implementation sensitivity; they do not alone establish different stochastic output distributions.
observational_prediction_boundary.observed_actions_warning: When a recorded action sequence is selected by a feedback policy, conditioning on A may reveal or select future disturbances and hidden states. F(S,A,U) having no Goal argument does not by itself remove Goal from P_train(Y | S,H,A,G_query). State physical invariance separately under frozen, executed do(A=a) and paired U.
observational_prediction_boundary.model_visible_history: H includes every model-visible non-language input: all supplied images, proprioception, past actions, time indices and any recurrent/cache state. Fix H, weights, inference settings and randomness for an implementation comparison. Complete model input history is not necessarily complete physical state.
observational_prediction_boundary.randomized_evaluation_boundary: Use the same preregistered compatible Goal pool for each compared physical instance, with assignment independent of hidden state. A state-dependent allowed-Goal pool can itself reveal hidden information. Randomization/full crossing defines independence only in that evaluation design, not training support or a pretrained observational predictor obligation.

WorldAgen.basis: Authors explicitly define a task-agnostic world head and claim instruction isolation via the mixed attention mask. Fixed-input text sensitivity can falsify this implementation contract without establishing harm.
WorldAgen.interpretation: Audit the stated architecture isolation contract with all non-language inputs/history fixed; separately measure calibrated forecast error and decision utility. An isolation violation is not by itself physical prediction error or task harm.

sections_supporting_isolation: 2.2 world model and history omit Goal
paper_qualification.inconsistent_wording: Section 2.6 world-step text also mentions task instruction; claim is scoped to the explicit architecture/formalization, not uniform wording throughout the paper.

AlphaBrain_and_CosmosPolicy.basis: Language-conditioned joint action/future prediction does not inherit WorldAgen task-agnostic promise. Native best-of-N fixes candidate controls for the future query, but intended conditioning must still be audited.
AlphaBrain_and_CosmosPolicy.interpretation: Do not label every forecast Goal dependence a violation. A branch-only Goal intervention needs a stated integrity/access boundary and independent evidence of error and task harm.

current_corrected_evidence.pair_selection: BDDL physical metadata equality, not forecast outcomes; initial state and environment remain Task 0.
current_corrected_evidence.target: Two-view CLIP-normalized RGB patch rearrangement, native camera orientation; no per-patch whitening in the actual LIBERO non-diffusion training path.
current_corrected_evidence.scope: Descriptive single-episode isolation and forecast-error evidence. No population confidence interval, native task-harm claim, or training-distribution sufficiency proof.

target_codec_provenance.qualification: Matches the published LIBERO training code path; full historical checkpoint training logs were not available.

next_evidence_gates.gate: Define the prediction contract before attack metrics
next_evidence_gates.pass_condition: Explicit physical target, full action horizon, preference-only Goal and model-specific isolation/intervention requirement.
next_evidence_gates.status: WorldAgen scope defined; universal goal-invariance rejected

next_evidence_gates.pass_condition: Held-out independent episodes and same-physical-scene preference goals, all valid permutations; preserve physical target and report conditional-support limitations.

Audit hidden-state information and training support; compare matched randomized-query evaluation and observational conditioning. A new full-state oracle or retrained goal-free model is a separate system, not proof about the released model.

next_evidence_gates.gate: Establish native decision harm and beneficial repair
next_evidence_gates.pass_condition: Healthy native clean baseline, fixed original policy/value Goal and candidates, actual environment utility, matched controls, measured clean cost of defense.
next_evidence_gates.status: Open for a reproducible harm-and-repair claim. The completed Cosmos fixed cyclic development panel has one actual closed-loop success loss (Clean 29/30, Swap 28/30); it fails the preregistered extension gate and does not establish universal Goal invariance or an external attack interface.

decision.go: Model-specific instruction-isolation audit and narrowly scoped calibrated prediction tests.
decision.no_go: Claiming universal physical prediction pollution, native attack success or useful defense from Goal dependence alone.

goal_roles.G_task: Original environment task, policy objective, value objective and success metric remain fixed.
goal_roles.G_query: Only the preference text supplied to the forecast query is intervened on; it must not alter physical reset, transition dynamics, controller semantics or the scored physical target.
goal_roles.integrity_boundary: An experimenter-controlled branch field is not evidence of a deployed attacker write interface.

related_action_alias_scope.scope: A fixed-belief action-intervention extension; does not assert that arbitrary Goal swaps preserve the belief or that observational training conditionals satisfy this contract.
related_action_alias_scope.clarification: Full state observability is sufficient but not necessary when equal executor kernels hold throughout a fixed belief and reachable support. Existing WorldAgen/Cosmos results and limits are unchanged.
